First large integration DAgger pass improved timing coverage but failed the frozen autonomous gate, primarily at half-heart starts.

Balanced base, broad-correction, and targeted-recovery training moved the failures but still missed the frozen fresh full-route gate.

integration_dagger_development.selection: Neither new checkpoint replaces the selected v3 guarded controller because both missed their precommitted autonomous gates.

unmodified_teacher.reason: Exact continuous branches reproduced the right-wall pin; the prior teacher could not escape after takeover.

disengagement_teacher.strategy: When the player is beyond x=132 and a Hardhat is within 40 Manhattan pixels, move left with B held for three frames, then resume the state-derived teacher.

full_route_integration.interpretation: Reliable guided result. Every cave run transferred to the teacher at decision zero, before the disagreeing proposal executed; this is not autonomous model performance.

entrance_fix: Tail Cave title dialogue is checked throughout the entrance corridor and dismissed whenever it begins, so continuous entry cannot stall at room 0x17 coordinate (80,101).
